raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ### What does this PR do? Fix ModelOpt QAT module ignore patterns so that they disable the module's child quantizers. For example, `*self_attention.linear_proj` currently matches neither `...linear_proj.input_quantizer` nor `...linear_proj.weight_quantizer`. Training therefore still applies fake quantization even when rollout explicitly keeps the corresponding `o_proj` in BF16. Keep the existing direct-quantizer rule and append a `pattern.*` rule. This preserves explicit quantizer selection and Megatron aliases, while respecting the module-name boundary (`in_proj_a` does not disable `in_proj_ab`). Duplicate check: [open ModelOpt/ignore PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+ModelOpt+ignore), [open ignore_patterns PRs](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+ignore_patterns). The related rollout matching work (#7918) and TE FP8 audit work (#8132) do not fix this ModelOpt module-to-child-quantizer matching path. No equivalent open fix was found. This addresses one concrete mismatch relevant to #8186, not that entire roadmap. ### Checklist Before Starting - [x] Search for similar PRs (queries above). - [x] Title format: `[megatron, ci] fix: honor module ignore patterns in ModelOpt QAT`. ### Test - `python -m pytest -q tests/utils/test_modelopt_mxfp8_on_gpu.py`: **34 passed** with ModelOpt 0.44.0/compressed-tensors 0.17.0, and **34 passed** with compressed-tensors 0.18.0. Tests exercise actual `mtq.quantize`, sibling isolation, direct quantizer patterns, aliases, unchanged presets, and exact BF16 forward/backward behavior. - Before the file rename, new tests applied to the unmodified baseline, `python -m pytest -q tests/utils/test_modelopt_mxfp8_on_cpu.py -k ignore`: **6 failed, 11 passed, 17 deselected**. - `pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always`: **all 14 hooks passed**. `git diff --check` passed. - **Actual H100 end-to-end experiment:** baseline and fixed Qwen3-0.6B each completed **10 GRPO optimizer updates** with Megatron/ModelOpt FP8 QAT and vLLM FP8_BLOCK rollout, using the same configuration and seed. One H100 80GB; TP/PP/CP/EP=1; 8 prompts × 2 samples; learning rate 1e-5; entropy coefficient 0.001. Packed inputs use an explicit causal attention override (`use_arbitrary_attention_mask=False`). | Instrumented check | Baseline | Fixed | | --- | --- | --- | | Enabled input/weight quantizers in 28 ignored output projections | 56/56 | 0/56 | | First ignored projection maximum QDQ error at every step | 0.0859375 | 0 | | Updates with changed first-projection weights | 10/10 | 10/10 | | BF16 exported weight exactly equals actual vLLM loaded weight | 11/11 | 11/11 | The refit check covers the first output-projection tensor at initialization and after every update. Baseline refit equality already holds; the fix removes unintended actor-side fake quantization. Both runs have finite nonzero gradients and actual parameter updates throughout, including batches whose GRPO advantages are zero. [Reproduction commands, exact environment, raw scalar/event records, and refit checks](https://github.com/LZC-BELIEVER/verl/tree/1a6bb8a727d27c00af3fbd0c4cc9b68e9a057d7e). Commands used are provided there: `run_training.py --arm baseline|fixed --steps 10 --tag run`, `verify_refits.py ... --steps 10`, and `plot_results.py --tag run`. These are single-seed arithmetic correctness runs. Mean reward was 0.7375 (baseline) versus 0.39375 (fixed); mean sampled K3 KL was 0.0115391 versus 0.0119434. The trajectories differ, so the curves do not demonstrate reward or whole-model KL improvement. Multi-GPU, MXFP8 end-to-end, and Qwen3.5/GDN experiments were not run. GitHub CI has not yet been requested. The renamed test module was revalidated: **34 passed** with each compressed-tensors version (0.17.0 and 0.18.0), **34 tests collected** using the GPU workflow exclusion rules, and all 14 pre-commit hooks passed. This review revision changes test discovery only; the H100 curves above were produced by the original fix. ### API and Usage Example No API change. Existing module patterns now take effect: ```yaml actor_rollout_ref: actor: megatron: qat: enable: true mode: fp8 ignore_patterns: ["lm_head", "*mlp.gate", "*self_attention.linear_proj"] rollout: quantization: linear: FP8_BLOCK moe: FP8_BLOCK ignore: ['re:.*self_attn\.o_proj$'] ``` Actor ModelOpt patterns use globs; rollout patterns shown here use the explicit regex prefix. Backend-specific names still need to correspond to the same layer. ### Design & Code Changes - Expand module ignores to child quantizers, retaining the original direct pattern. - Replace the string-only regression assertion with behavioral quantization checks and cover FP8/MXFP8 and BF16 gradient preservation. - Rename the test file to `test_modelopt_mxfp8_on_gpu.py` so the existing GPU unit-test command discovers it automatically in an environment with ModelOpt/compressed-tensors. No separate workflow step is needed. AI assistance (Codex) was used for the implementation, tests, experiment instrumentation, and description. And human reviewer had checked every line. ### Checklist Before Submitting - [x] Human submitter has read the contribution guide and reviewed every changed line. - [x] Apply pre-commit checks (results above). - [ ] Add/update documentation: no configuration/API additions; usage is illustrated above. - [x] Add regression coverage to the CI workflow. - [x] Request CI in `ci-request` or the Feishu group once the human review is complete. - [ ] Recipe submodule update: not applicable.

 # See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
 # limitations under the License.
 
+import copy
 from types import SimpleNamespace
 
 import pytest
@@ -65,14 +66,71 @@ def test_mxfp8_qat_appends_user_ignores_without_mutating_modelopt_preset():
 
     config = build_quantize_config("mxfp8", ["*linear_attn.in_proj_a"])
 
-    assert config["quant_cfg"][:-1] == original
-    assert config["quant_cfg"][-1] == {
-        "quantizer_name": "*linear_attn.in_proj_a",
-        "enable": False,
-    }
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.linear_attn = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.linear_attn.in_proj_a = torch.nn.Linear(128, 32, bias=False)
+    model.linear_attn.in_proj_ab = torch.nn.Linear(128, 128, bias=False)
+    mtq.quantize(model, config)
+
+    assert not model.linear_attn.in_proj_a.input_quantizer.is_enabled
+    assert not model.linear_attn.in_proj_a.weight_quantizer.is_enabled
+    assert model.linear_attn.in_proj_ab.input_quantizer.is_enabled
+    assert model.linear_attn.in_proj_ab.weight_quantizer.is_enabled
     assert mtq.normalize_quant_cfg_list(mtq.MXFP8_DEFAULT_CFG["quant_cfg"]) == original
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["fp8", "mxfp8"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "pattern, input_enabled, weight_enabled",
+    [
+        ("projection", False, False),
+        ("projectio?", False, False),
+        ("projection.*", False, False),
+        ("projection.weight_quantizer", True, False),
+        ("*input_quantizer", False, True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_qat_ignore_module_and_quantizer_patterns(mode, pattern, input_enabled, weight_enabled):
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.projection = torch.nn.Linear(128, 128, bias=False)
+    mtq.quantize(model, build_quantize_config(mode, [pattern]))
+
+    assert model.projection.input_quantizer.is_enabled == input_enabled
+    assert model.projection.weight_quantizer.is_enabled == weight_enabled
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "pattern, module_name", [("lm_head", "output_layer"), ("*mlp.gate", "router"), ("*self_attn*", "self_attention")]
+)
+def test_qat_ignore_keeps_megatron_aliases(pattern, module_name):
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.add_module(module_name, torch.nn.Linear(128, 128, bias=False))
+    mtq.quantize(model, build_quantize_config("fp8", [pattern]))
+
+    layer = model.get_submodule(module_name)
+    assert not layer.input_quantizer.is_enabled
+    assert not layer.weight_quantizer.is_enabled
+
+
+def test_fp8_ignored_module_preserves_forward_and_backward():
+    torch.manual_seed(7)
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.projection = torch.nn.Linear(128, 32, bias=False).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    reference = copy.deepcopy(model.projection)
+    mtq.quantize(model, build_quantize_config("fp8", ["projection"]))
+    inputs = torch.randn(16, 128, dtype=torch.bfloat16, requires_grad=True)
+    reference_inputs = inputs.detach().clone().requires_grad_(True)
+
+    actual = model.projection(inputs)
+    expected = reference(reference_inputs)
+    actual.float().square().mean().backward()
+    expected.float().square().mean().backward()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(model.projection.weight.grad, reference.weight.grad, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(inputs.grad, reference_inputs.grad, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+
 def test_mxfp8_rollout_requires_explicit_shape_ignore():
     pattern = r"re:.*linear_attn\.in_proj_[ab]$"

@@ -288,6 +288,9 @@ def _ignore_patterns_to_quant_cfg(ignore_patterns: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
     for pattern in ignore_patterns:
         key = mapping.get(pattern, pattern)
         cfg.append({"quantizer_name": key, "enable": False})
+        # Module patterns must also match their child quantizers. Keep the
+        # original rule for callers that already name quantizers explicitly.
+        cfg.append({"quantizer_name": f"{key}.*", "enable": False})
     return cfg
